name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: How the NYT Reported on Khamenei’s Funeral in Iran
changes.summary: Our correspondent talked about the challenges of covering major news while under surveillance and filing his work without reliable internet access.

changes.title: Diesel Prices Hit $5 a Gallon Again, Up 33% Since Start of Iran War
changes.summary: U.S. diesel prices first surpassed $5 a gallon in March. Renewed fighting in the Persian Gulf and reduced refinery capacity is once again pushing up prices.

changes.title: Karoline Leavitt answers questions on Trump's primetime speech, new Iran strikes
changes.summary: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt spoke to reporters Thursday about President Trump's upcoming primetime speech, the latest strikes against Iran and more.

changes.title: On the War Against Iran, the Pentagon Has Said Little
changes.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has spoken about a range of issues in recent days — from testosterone to leak investigations — but he has said little about the war.

changes.title: Trump's Iran notice aims to reset war powers clock amid growing political risks
changes.summary: The Trump administration's notification to restart the war with Iran aims to reset a 60-day clock for military action, but questions are mounting about public support as midterms approach.

changes.title: U.S. citizen departs Iran after being barred from leaving for over a year
changes.summary: A U.S.-Iranian woman who was trapped in Iran on allegations of espionage and collaborating with a hostile state that her attorney called "bogus" has departed the country, CBS News learned Wednesday.

changes.title: U.S., Iran in a "new phase" of the conflict, retired Navy vice admiral explains
changes.summary: U.S. Central Command confirmed it began a second wave of strikes against Iran on Wednesday, following a round of attacks earlier in the day. Retired Navy Vice Adm. Robert Murrett joins CBS News to discuss.

changes.title: The political risks from war in Iran. And, ICE's use of force is rising, report finds
changes.summary: The political implications the war in Iran is having on the GOP. And, a new report has found that ICE officers' use of force is not rare since President Trump took office for his second term. (Image credit: -/AFP via Getty Images).
